// C# の見本
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Sample.Geo;

/// <summary>XML doc の <see cref="Point"/></summary>
[Serializable]
public sealed record Point(double X, double Y) : IComparable<Point>
{
    public static readonly Point Origin = new(0, 0);
    public int CompareTo(Point? other) => X.CompareTo(other?.X ?? 0);
}

public partial class Repository<T> : IDisposable where T : class, new()
{
    private readonly List<T> _items = new();
    private const int Max = 0x1F;
    public event EventHandler<T>? Added;
    public int Count => _items.Count;
    public T this[int index] { get => _items[index]; set => _items[index] = value; }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyList<T>> LoadAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        await using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
        var query = from item in _items
                    where item != null
                    orderby item.GetHashCode() descending
                    select item;
        return query.Take(Max).ToList();
    }

    public void Dispose() { GC.SuppressFinalize(this); }
}

public static class Program
{
    public static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        var name = args.Length > 0 ? args[0] : "world";
        string verbatim = @"C:\path\""quoted""";
        string interp = $"Hello, {name,-10:F2} {{literal}}";
        string raw = """
            raw "string"
            """;
        object o = 1.5e-3m;
        switch (o)
        {
            case int i when i > 0: Console.WriteLine(i); break;
            case decimal d: Console.WriteLine($"{d}"); break;
            default: throw new InvalidOperationException(nameof(o));
        }
        #region 区切り
        Func<int, int> sq = x => x * x;
        #endregion
        return sq(args.Length) + 1_000;
    }
}
